mechanism: Erythromycin may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of systemically absorbed timolol, potentially increasing beta-blocker effects; additive cardiac depression risk exists despite topical timolol administration.
action: Monitor for increased beta-blocker adverse effects (bradycardia, hypotension, bronchospasm); consider alternative macrolide if systemic beta-blocker effects develop, or monitor cardiac parameters closely during concurrent use.
